subject: Re: Evidence request — code review trail, keystore rotation & deployment gate authorization
messages:
From: Alicia Park <alicia.park@hexagonfin.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@hexagonfin.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Secure SDLC evidence request — code review, keystore rotation, deployment gate

Hi Grace,

Thanks for taking this. As part of Hexagon's SIG review we need a compact evidence bundle covering the following areas for Redwood's inference product:

- Code review provenance for recent high-risk changes (PRs touching keystore or auth code)
- CI/CD controls: which jobs gate deploys, test coverage thresholds, protected branches
- Keystore rotation proof: last rotation date, who performed it, rotation instructions/logs
- Deployment gate approvals: who authorized, timestamped checklist, rollback steps

Can you provide: a short, machine-readable list of PRs + reviewers, build job IDs and timestamps, the keystore rotation log (CSV or similar), and a signed deployment gate checklist? Ideally as a small bundle or S3 link. We have an auditor slot next week (Mon 24th), so if we can get this by Monday EOD PT that would be great.

Also flag anything scoped as sensitive so we can request appropriate access.

Appreciate it — let me know if you want a call to walk through the ask.

Best,
Alicia Park
Security Program Manager
Hexagon Financial

--
Attachments: hexagon_sig_scope_v2.pdf (referenced, not attached here)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Park <alicia.park@hexagonfin.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Secure SDLC evidence request — code review, keystore rotation, deployment gate

Alicia — thanks for the clear list. We'll assemble a focused bundle targeted at those four bullets. Plan: 

1) Neha will pull the CI job history, test gating rules, and the keystore rotation evidence.
2) Marissa will pull the PR reviews and diffs for the specific auth/keystore PRs.
3) I'll provide a signed deployment gate checklist (or confirm the signed PDF) and call out any items that require restricted access.

Targeting a drop (S3 link + small PDF attachments) by Mon 24 Jul EOD PT — if anything looks like it needs redaction or a separate access grant we'll flag it in the bundle index.

Neha / Marissa — can you confirm you have the artifacts and estimate ETA? I'll be the named approver for the deployment gate checklist.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0132

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Alicia Park <alicia.park@hexagonfin.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Secure SDLC evidence request — artifacts (S3 bundle + attachments)

Hi all — attaching a small bundle and listing the key pieces below. Per Grace, I pulled these from the audit bucket and our CI history. Links are internal; external access can be granted to Hexagon via presigned URLs if needed.

S3 bundle: s3://redwood-audit-bundles/hexagon/2028-07-20/ (index + objects)
Included artifacts (high level):
- keystore_rotation_log_20280715.csv — rotation ran 2028-07-15T03:21:14Z, rotated by ops@redwood.com (uid: op-42). Entry includes previous key ID, new key ID, rotation TTL, and rotation playbook reference.
- pr-927-diff.txt — diff for PR #927 (auth/keystore changes). Reviewers: marissa.cole, rishi.malhotra. Merge: 2028-07-14T22:10:35Z.
- ci-job-history.csv — build job IDs and timestamps for the last 30 days; gates are job:security-tests (run IDs: build-8812, build-8836, build-8872) — passing required checks before merge.
- deployment_gate_checklist_signed.pdf — signed checklist; Grace approved on 2028-07-20T10:45:00-07:00 (I obtained sign-off and attached the PDF).

Notes / quick commands to verify:
- To view PR review trail: git log --merges --pretty=format:'%h %an %ad %s' origin/main..origin/release-auth | grep PR-927
- To review CI job details: circleci build --job security-tests --limit 50 --filter 'build-8836' (internal access required)

I've attached the three files referenced above for convenience. If Hexagon needs presigned links instead of the bucket path let me know and I'll generate.

Attachments: keystore_rotation_log_20280715.csv, pr-927-diff.txt, deployment_gate_checklist_signed.pdf

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Senior DevOps Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Alicia Park <alicia.park@hexagonfin.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 11:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Secure SDLC evidence request — PR diffs and reviewers

Adding a couple of specifics to Neha's bundle for the reviewer record:

- PR #927 (auth/keystore): changed files src/auth/keystore_manager.py, tests/test_keystore_rotation.py
  - Reviewers: marissa.cole, rishi.malhotra
  - Review comments: all resolved (see pr-927-diff.txt)
  - Merge commit: c3f1b7a — merged to main 2028-07-14 22:10:35 UTC

- Additional PRs that touched certificate handling: #914, #920 (included in the bundle index).

If the auditor wants a direct view in GitHub/GitLab we can generate a short-lived read-only link to the repo slice; else the diff file is sufficient for now.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Software Engineering Manager, Inference Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Secure SDLC evidence request — follow-up on rotation frequency

Quick follow-up: the keystore rotation CSV shows a TTL of 365 days and the last rotation on 2028-07-15. For SIG I expect the auditor to ask whether the rotation schedule is enforced automatically or manual and who has the authority to initiate emergency rotations.

Answering here for the record: rotation is automated by ops-runner with a manual override; emergency rotations require ops lead + security approval (Grace). We can add a short note to the bundle index (I can draft a 1-paragraph rationale).

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Staff Engineer, Runtime Security
Redwood Inference

From: Alicia Park <alicia.park@hexagonfin.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@hexagonfin.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Secure SDLC evidence request — confirmation of receipt

Thanks, team — I pulled the S3 index and downloaded the three attachments you included. The keystore CSV and the signed checklist cover the rotation and gate authorization items we needed. A couple of quick notes from the auditor:

- They may ask for the GitHub read-only link during the live session; could you generate one before Mon 24th?
- For the emergency rotation flow we might request the on-call runbook CAIQ reference — if you can add a short paragraph to the bundle index that summarizes the manual override process (who authorizes + escalation steps) that will speed the review.

Procurement — will follow up separately on any PO items.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Alicia
